recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13821 unless a work group separately reopens the broader current ServiceRequest insurance design; historical STU3 publication artifacts are outside this reconciliation branch.
issue_request: FHIR-13821 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request for ReferralRequest and ProcedureRequest. It originally proposed an insurance backbone, but the accepted resolution was to add insurance 0..* Reference(Coverage|ClaimResponse), using ClaimResponse for pre-authorization details.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as pre-applied in SVN#12374. The corresponding git-svn commit 5064224bd079b7f4ef4023d3ead9111b57bd8bff added Request.insurance to the workflow Request logical model with Reference(Coverage|ClaimResponse), and explicit GF#13821 commit 8bb46dd1d6cc468f2f90e42d54106e5e09b116cb added ServiceRequest.insurance with the same cardinality, targets, definition, and mappings.
additional_context: The current build no longer has active ProcedureRequest or ReferralRequest resources. source/fhir.ini lists servicerequest as an active resource, request as an active logical model, ReferralRequest under removed resources, and comments that ProcedureRequest merged into ServiceRequest and ReferralRequest became ServiceRequest. The latest combined branch source has ServiceRequest.insurance as 0..* Reference(Coverage|ClaimResponse), mapped to Request.insurance. Related typo cleanup for Request.insurance is already represented on the combined branch by FHIR-14119 and does not alter this outcome.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active ServiceRequest source and Request logical model already implement the accepted FHIR-13821 resolution, while the named historical STU3 resources are out of current build scope.

related_jiras.note: Separate Published typo correction for Request.insurance wording; already audited on the combined branch and not a missing source change for FHIR-13821.
